title: Radioactive Party Panthers from Fort Lauderdale
description: The first and only film by Ron Bergman about radioactive panthers terrorizing partygoers in Florida.
quote: By my calculations, we have seven hours until the panthers merge into one giant mega-panther.
alt1: David Faustino with one huge arm, holding a gun on a jetski
alt2: colorful panthers chasing women around a pool
alt4: woman scientist in a bikini under her labcoat
